mechanism.claim: When BTC's completed six-hour and twenty-four-hour returns agree with ETH's completed six-hour return, short and daily BTC trends are confirmed by the most liquid crypto risk proxy. In a high-variation state, the cross-market trend persists for the next day.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of BTC 6h, BTC 24h, and ETH 6h returns
mechanism.why_distinct: STCR used BTC-only 3d/14d trends at Monday/Thursday decisions with a 72h hold and no volatility gate. ETH leadership candidates used lead-lag or residual disagreement. CMMTCR uses same-time BTC multi-horizon plus ETH confirmation at a daily 02:00 clock, reuses no event set, and promotes no control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC 24-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse 02:05 UTC daily cross-market clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source: exact contiguous bars_binance 1m BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT rows
features.concordance: all three finite strict nonzero returns have the same sign
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC 1m close/open log returns over [decision-24h,decision))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid daily observations, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: daily 02:00 UTC after all paths complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-market multi-horizon trend confirmation in volatile BTC

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no market, horizon, concordance, volatility, side, clock, hold, subset, or control repair
